hero.sub: WhatsApp gives you two ticks. Trik adds the third: every cash-on-delivery order is confirmed with the customer in the chat before it ships.
hero.note: The pilot opens soon for 10–20 sellers.

problem.title: Sellers sell in the chat. Orders break after it.

items.title: Orders are not confirmed
items.body: Orders arrive in WhatsApp and from the store. Someone confirms them by hand, if at all, so fake, duplicate and impulse orders ship anyway.

items.title: Refusals eat the margin
items.body: A refused cash-on-delivery parcel costs shipping both ways and the ad that brought it. Most sellers never see that per order.

items.title: Nothing is connected
items.body: The chat, the store, couriers, payments and ad spend live in different places, so nobody knows the real profit.

road.title: From the first message to cash in your hand.

steps.name: Chat
steps.body: The customer orders in WhatsApp or in your store.

steps.name: Trik'd
steps.body: Confirmed in the chat, before anything ships.

steps.name: Deposit
steps.body: Asked only when the refusal risk is high.

steps.name: Courier
steps.body: Sent with the courier that delivers best in that area.

steps.name: Delivered
steps.body: Rescued in the chat if an attempt fails.

steps.name: Cash
steps.body: Collected and matched to the order.

steps.name: Profit
steps.body: Known per order, after shipping and ads.

board.title: Watch the queue confirm itself.
board.sub: Every order moves on its own: WhatsApp message, then a reminder, then a call. Your team only touches what's left. Try confirming one.

calc.title: What refusals cost you every month.
calc.sub: Shipping out, shipping back, and the ad that brought the order. Move the sliders to your own numbers. Nothing leaves your browser.
calc.disclaimer: Trik doesn't promise a number. It confirms each order before it ships, so you can watch this one go down.

features.title: Trik it before you ship it.
features.sub: Four tools that work as one, built for teams of 1 to 50 who sell in the chat.

inbox.title: One shared inbox
inbox.short: The whole team on one WhatsApp number, one conversation per customer, the order beside the chat.
inbox.headline: Every chat, every agent, one number.
inbox.sub: Stop passing one phone around. Your team answers from one WhatsApp number, sees who is on which chat, and has the order card right next to the conversation.

points.title: One conversation per customer
points.body: Every message from the same customer lands in one thread, with their past orders and refusals on the side.

points.title: The 24-hour window, handled
points.body: Trik shows when the free reply window closes and switches to approved templates when it does.

points.title: Badges across brands
points.body: Run more than one store? See unread chats for every workspace from one switcher.

confirmation.title: Confirmation on autopilot
confirmation.short: Every COD order gets a message, then a reminder, then a call. Confirm the rest in bulk.
confirmation.headline: Every COD order confirmed in the chat.
confirmation.sub: A message with Confirm and Change buttons goes out the moment the order arrives. No answer? A reminder, then the call queue. Your team works one board instead of a spreadsheet.

points.title: A ladder, not a guess
points.body: WhatsApp, reminder, call: each step waits the time you choose before the next.

points.title: Changes in the chat
points.body: Size, address or delivery day: the customer replies, the order card updates.

points.title: Bulk actions
points.body: Confirm, remind, queue a call or cancel many orders from the board at once.

risk.title: Refusal risk, explained
risk.short: A score with the reason for every order. Ask a deposit only where it matters.
risk.headline: Know which orders will come back.
risk.sub: Every order gets a refusal risk score with the reasons behind it. High risk asks for a small deposit; good customers are never bothered.

points.title: A reason, not just a number
points.body: Past refusals, a new number, an unclear address: you see why, in plain words.

points.title: Deposits only when needed
points.body: Set the score that triggers a deposit. Paid deposits are taken off the amount due on delivery.

points.title: Filter the board by risk
points.body: Work the riskiest orders first, or hold them until they're confirmed.

stores.title: Orders from every store
stores.short: Shopify and EasyOrders orders land beside the ones taken in chat.
stores.headline: Every order in one place, wherever it came from.
stores.sub: Connect your store once. New orders arrive by themselves and go through the same confirmation, with the status written back to the store.

points.title: Shopify and EasyOrders
points.body: Install in a few clicks. More stores are on the way.

points.title: Orders taken in chat
points.body: Agents create orders right in the conversation: the same card, the same confirmation.

points.title: No duplicates
points.body: Each order is recorded once per source, however many times the store sends it.

how.title: Live on your own number in an afternoon.
how.sub: No new phone, no new app for your customers. They keep talking to you on WhatsApp.

steps.title: Connect WhatsApp
steps.body: Sign in with Meta and connect the number your customers already know. Keep using the WhatsApp Business app beside Trik if you want.

steps.title: Connect your store
steps.body: Install Trik on Shopify or EasyOrders, or take orders in the chat only.

steps.title: Set your confirmation rules
steps.body: Choose the messages, the reminder timing, and the risk score that asks for a deposit.

steps.title: Go live
steps.body: New orders start confirming themselves. Your team works the board and the inbox.

faq.a: Cancel from settings at any time and export your data.
